parameters.query: SELECT v.id, v.word, v.transliteration, t.translation, l.code, vv.genre, j.ord FROM vocabag_videos vv CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(vv.word_ids, '$[*]' COLUMNS (ord FOR ORDINALITY, wid INT PATH '$')) j JOIN vocabulary v ON v.id = j.wid JOIN languages l ON l.id = v.language_id JOIN vocabulary_translations t ON t.vocabulary_id = v.id AND t.target_locale = 'fr' WHERE vv.id = (SELECT MAX(id) FROM vocabag_videos WHERE posted_on_instagram = 1 AND posted_instagram_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 20 HOUR) ORDER BY j.ord
SELECT folder FROM vocabag_videos WHERE posted_on_instagram = 1 AND posted_instagram_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL 20 HOUR ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
